title: Empty or Zero Input Handling
description: The function does not handle empty or zero input values for `transaction_type`, `amount_cents`, or `description`. This could lead to unexpected behavior or errors.
snippet:
def create_transaction(
    db: Session,
    transaction_type: str,
    amount_cents: int,
    description: str
) -> Transaction:
    db_transaction = Transaction(
        type=transaction_type,
        amount_cents=amount_cents,
        description=description
    )
    db.add(db_transaction)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_transaction)
    return db_transaction

title: Incorrect return type for `get_transaction_by_id`

snippet:
def get_transaction_by_id(db: Session, transaction_id: int) -> Optional[Transaction]:

title: No income transactions handled
description: The function does not check if there are any income transactions before attempting to sum their amounts. This can lead to a TypeError if there are no income transactions.
snippet:
def calculate_total_income(db: Session) -> int:
    transactions = db.query(Transaction).filter(Transaction.type == "income").all()
    total = sum(t.amount_cents for t in transactions)
    return total

title: Database population check is missing
description: The function does not check if the database already contains transactions before attempting to seed it. This can lead to duplicate entries or errors if the database is not empty.
snippet:
def seed_database():
    init_db()
    db = SessionLocal()
    
    existing = db.query(Transaction).first()
    if existing:
        print("Database already has data. Skipping seed.")
        db.close()
        return
    
    sample_transactions = [
        Transaction(
            type="income",
            amount_cents=5000000,
            description="Monthly Salary",
            created_at=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=5)
        ),
        Transaction(
            type="expense",
            amount_cents=120000,
            description="Grocery Shopping",
            created_at=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=4)
        ),
        Transaction(
            type="expense",
            amount_cents=85000,
            description="Electricity Bill",
            created_at=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=3)
        ),
        Transaction(
            type="expense",
            amount_cents=250000,
            description="Restaurant Dinner",
            created_at=datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=1)
        ),
    ]
    
    for transaction in sample_transactions:
        db.add(transaction)
    
    db.commit()
    print("Sample data seeded successfully!")
    print("Balance should be: ₹45,450.00")
    db.close()
